subject: Operability: Northshore on‑prem throughput degradation and p95 spike
body:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@northshore-health.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Rao <anita.rao@northshore-health.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 08:02:12 -0700
Subject: Realtime cluster: p95 spike + 503s in DC-3 (urgent)

Hi Irene / Marissa,

We started seeing a steady rise in request p95 and intermittent 503s on our on‑prem cluster in DC‑3 starting ~07:40 PDT. Traffic profile is unchanged; nothing in our deploy cadence. The spike correlates with a burst of multi‑segment inference calls from our call‑centers region.

Attached: northshore_kv_dump_20280502.log and p95_reports_may02.pdf (sample traces and recent SLO breach screenshots).

Can Redwood triage — we need a recommended mitigation and a timeline. Anita is copied for visibility.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Ops Lead, Northshore Health

---
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@northshore-health.com>, ops@northshore-health.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 08:23:49 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime cluster: p95 spike + 503s in DC-3 (urgent)

Sanjay — thanks for the quick heads up and the artifacts. I pulled the logs and the KV dump; we see a mix of elevated KV cache churn and decode queueing on host set r3-*.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm if there were any large batch replays or bulk inference jobs started at ~07:35? (even internal maintenance runs can trigger this pattern)
- If possible, route any non‑urgent traffic to your fallback region for the next 45m.

I'm escalating to our on‑prem performance team and looping Priyom and Vivek for a deep dive. We'll propose a short remediation play within 30 minutes.

Irene Choi
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 08:35:03 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Northshore DC-3 p95 spike — quick triage notes

Forwarding artifacts from Northshore. Initial read: KV cache churn causing frequent remote pageups and repeated model checkpoint coldloads on a subset of hosts (r3-12 -> r3-18). Also visible: token decode queue backlog hitting concurrency limits on the decode worker pool.

Quick mitigation candidates (ordered):
1) Apply hotfix: increase local KV cache size by 20% and raise max_concurrency decode pool from 24 -> 30 on affected hosts (fast config reload).
2) Short term: route heavy multi‑segment calls to a sharded fallback model variant (lower memory overhead) to reduce KV collisions.
3) Medium term: add prefix caching for call‑center sequences we can identify (requires small rule update).

I'll prepare a config diff to patch hosts. Vivek — can you validate if the cache bump has impact on OOM risk? Hannah — can you stand by to coordinate Dokken/Customer CS comms?

Priyom
SRE, Redwood Inference

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 09:02:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Northshore DC-3 p95 spike — quick triage notes

Quick check: increasing KV size by 20% on r3-12..18 looks safe—observed headroom on RAM is ~28% on those hosts. We'll push the config patch as a rolling change to avoid simultaneous cache resizing.

I've prepared the minimal playbook patch (playbook_patch.diff attached) that:
- raises kv.local_cache.max_size from 12GB -> 14.4GB for affected hosts
- updates decode.max_concurrency from 24 -> 30 with a 10s ramp per process
- enables 'prefix_cache_hint' for the top 10 call‑center prefixes (this is safe and non‑disruptive)

Rolling plan: 1 host every 90s for r3-12..r3-18. Monitor p95 and 503 rate after each host. If 503 reduction < 60% after 5 hosts, we'll pause and rollback.

ETA for first host patch start: 09:12 PDT (20 minutes). I will post runbook links and the live dashboard to the shared Drive.

Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. SW Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

---
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@northshore-health.com>, ops@northshore-health.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 09:22:46 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime cluster: p95 spike + 503s in DC-3 (urgent)

Sanjay — we're starting the rolling patch at 09:12 PDT (r3-12 first). Plan: one host every 90s, monitor closely, and share live metrics. Marissa will be your CS lead on status and will coordinate any customer routing changes if needed.

Key asks of Northshore before we begin:
- Pause any bulk inference/replay jobs for next 60 minutes if possible.
- Share CIDR for call‑center burst traffic if you need us to apply routing caps instead of region failover.

I will send updates here as we progress.

Irene

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@northshore-health.com>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@northshore-health.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 09:43:05 -07:00
Subject: Patch started — immediate status and next steps

Thanks Sanjay — quick status: we started rolling at 09:12 PDT; r3-12 and r3-13 rolled, p95 improved ~35% and 503 rate dropped by ~48% on those hosts. We're continuing the roll; next check after r3-15 completes.

If you see any persistent errors on your side please attach the request id / timestamp and we'll correlate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

---
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@northshore-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Rao <anita.rao@northshore-health.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Patch started — immediate status and next steps

Team — big thanks. We're seeing reduced user impact and the ticket can be de‑escalated from Anita's side for now. We'll hold on bulk replays for the next 2 hours and share CIDR if needed. Please keep me posted on the remainder of the roll.

Sanjay

[End of thread]
